actor_separation: Actor VIEWs retain opaque part handles, never this trusted day field. Private MOUNTS/lineage joins map handles to complete original day/row rosters. Original day ordinal is an actor predictor only through permitted C context. No entire private mapping or bank mount.

array_descriptor.adapter: Mechanically nest the unchanged bytes/SHA under pin; no body or identity conversion.

arrays: Exactly mask/offsets plus x unless C and context unless N. Labels forbidden for predict/features; fit selects one endpoint only.
membership: Request assigned_days and assigned_ids must exactly match ordered part.day and concatenated part.ids BEFORE any NPY body reads. Fit also matches scope.training_days/training_ids. Predict/features use independently admitted assigned rosters. Empty day is an explicit part with ids=[] and valid zero-row arrays. Exact full common channel axis remains required.

numeric_batch.parts: Ordered list of {day,ids,axis,arrays,labels?}. day is the positive original day ordinal in TRUSTED REFERENCE requests only; labels, when fit, is one selected-endpoint descriptor per part. No top-level labels in parts mode.

status: Normative source-only serialization clarification; no data, model, fixture or runtime operation.
